risk_note: RV2 (risk three-dimension rate limiting, stage ⑬; BR-ID-01 判定顺序, 02 §12.2 限流, 06 Q-B4 defaults, 04 §7 42901). User / device / IP token buckets in Redis (one Lua call judges every dimension and rule first and spends only when all can pay; integer token units; keys carry TTL ≥ window and no plain identifiers), thresholds per interface group from content config (rate_limit.<group>, rate_limit.ops) with code defaults, 42901 + Retry-After, store outage refuses with alert logs, wired after ④a on the guard chain and in the idempotency post-miss hook, disabled without Redis. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
